_note: The Bone Steppe, level 18: cold wind and giant bones. See docs/zones.md.

bone_steppe.name: the Bone Steppe
bone_steppe.description: A cold, windy grassland strewn with the bones of things the size of hills.

exposure.name: cold
exposure.warn: The wind cuts through you. Get to the yurts.
exposure.hurt: The steppe wind is freezing you to death.

bs_landing.name: Where the Sky Fell
bs_landing.description: A crater in the grass where fallers from the sky land. The clan keeps it soft with hay.

bs_yurts.name: The Clan Yurts
bs_yurts.description: Felt yurts in a ring, smoke from every one. Horses with frost in their manes.

bs_ribs.name: The Ribcage Hills
bs_ribs.description: Hills that are ribs, each as tall as a tower.

bs_spine.name: The Great Spine
bs_spine.description: A spine of vertebrae running to the horizon. Drakes nest in the gaps.

bs_skull.name: Skull Hill
bs_skull.description: A skull the size of a castle. The wind howls through its eyes.

bs_pit.name: The Marrow Pit
bs_pit.description: A pit full of bone-marrow gone to stone, and something huge rising out of it.

bs_crater.name: The Crater Rim
bs_crater.description: The rim of a fresh crater. At the bottom, the ground glows, and the sky above it is full of falling stars.

features.crater: Down there, a realm where the stars come down.

temur.name: Khagan Temur
temur.label: Khagan
temur.description: a broad man in furs with a horse-tail standard
temur.details: A broad man in furs with a horse-tail standard.

topics.work: Ask me about the drakes, or the titan.

drakes.text: Bone-drakes take our horses. Five of them, from the Ribcage Hills. Their breath: dodge it.

titan.text: The Marrow Titan is rising out of its pit. If it walks, the steppe dies. Block its stomp, if you can.

fire.text: My shaman's fire goes to your city, if you want to go home.
fire.explains: TRAVEL TEMPLE STEPS to take it.

steppe_furs.name: Steppe Furs
steppe_furs.description: Clan furs over hardened leather. Keeps off the cold. +2 Vigor.

steppe_clans.name: The Steppe Clans
steppe_clans.description: The horse clans of the Bone Steppe. They respect strength and keep their word.

steppe-fire.name: the shaman's fire
steppe-fire.depart: The clan shaman throws a handful of bone-dust on the fire. You step into the smoke, and out onto Harrowgate's temple steps.
steppe-fire.arrive: {actor} steps out of a wisp of smoke on the temple steps.

crater-road.name: the crater road
crater-road.depart: You climb down into the crater, and the sky changes.
crater-road.arrive: {actor} climbs out of a crater under a burning sky.
